repair_gain.method: paired percentile bootstrap over tasks, 95% interval
repair_gain.reading: Change in feasible success from the verified first attempt (config 2) to up to k = 3 further verified rounds with findings (config 3), on the same tasks. It includes the effect of the extra attempts, so it does not by itself credit the feedback; the feedback gain (3 - 7) addresses that question at equal budget.

feedback_gain.method: paired percentile bootstrap over tasks, 95% interval
feedback_gain.reading: Repair with verifier findings (config 3) minus equal-budget resampling without feedback (config 7), on the same tasks: the comparison that separates the effect of feedback from retrying at the same budget.
feedback_gain.label: Nebius Token Factory run (headline source)
